question: Can three narrower questions about the 70-coin multi-premia blend be answered well before the 180-day review: is it implementable as modeled, is it clearly broken, and is the edge a MEXC data artifact?
registration_note: Declared 2026-10-04, before the paper account's first day (2026-10-05) and before any venue-replication run. Thresholds come from a fixed calibration procedure (below) that uses only data before 2026-10-05: the development sample (2020-06-01 to 2026-09-12) and a pre-start paper replay. Forward blend days already seen (09-29 to 10-03) are not used and are not scored here. Gates count from 2026-10-05. They add new questions; they do not shorten or replace the 180-day reviews in config/forward_formal_reviews_v*.json.

G1_implementation.question: Does the paper account (lots, minimum orders, fees, slippage, MEXC funding) track the theoretical V_ALL book?
G1_implementation.inputs: paper_account_report.json daily_returns.paper vs human_report.json daily_returns.V_ALL, matched by UTC date (both cover d-1 08:00 to d 08:00); difference = paper - V_ALL
G1_implementation.calibration: replay the paper account from 2026-04-05 to 2026-10-04 with current MEXC contract specs; m = mean daily difference, s_N = std of rolling N-day sums of the difference, te = annualized std of the daily difference

rules.data: scored days >= calendar days elapsed - 2 and coins_with_data >= 63
rules.band: cumulative difference over the scored days within m*N +/- 3*s_N
rules.tracking_error: annualized std of the daily difference <= 2 * te

G1_implementation.verdict: day 30: ON_TRACK / OFF_TRACK (descriptive); day 60: PASS if all three rules hold, else FAIL

G2_breakage_alarm.question: Is the blend clearly broken, judged against its own history?
G2_breakage_alarm.calibration: S4 development series (2020-06-01 to 2026-09-12, MEXC prices, Binance funding, the frozen rules); demean and add back a mean giving annualized Sharpe 1.39 (the untouched-coins holdout estimate); stationary block bootstrap, mean block 20 days, 20000 paths of 180 days, seed 20261004

rules.drawdown: ALARM if the max drawdown since 2026-10-05 is worse than the 2.5th percentile of the 180-day max drawdown
rules.rolling_60d: ALARM if any 60-day cumulative return (from day 60) is below the 2.5th percentile of the minimum rolling 60-day return over 180 days

G2_breakage_alarm.false_alarm_rate: <= 5% over the 180 days if the true Sharpe is 1.39 (each rule 2.5%, whole window, not per look)
G2_breakage_alarm.verdict: OK or ALARM (sticky); ALARM means the formal 180-day review is expected to fail, it does not stop the watch

G3_venue_replication.question: Does the blend survive on other venues' prices and funding?
G3_venue_replication.method: rerun the frozen multi-premia-v1 rules unchanged (S1 trend core, S2 XS momentum, S3 XS carry, S4 equal-risk blend; 20 bps round trip) over the development window 2020-06-01 to 2026-09-12 on (a) Binance USDT-M 8h klines + Binance funding, (b) Bybit linear 4h klines resampled to 8h (00/08/16 UTC) + Bybit funding. Symbol map as the development run (FILECOIN->FIL, TRUMPOFFICIAL->TRUMP, PUMPFUN->PUMP, then a 1000-prefixed contract if the plain one is missing). The MEXC reference is recomputed on the same coins (development cache).
G3_venue_replication.pass_rule_per_venue: at least 40 of the 70 coins available, S4 annualized Sharpe >= 0.5 x the MEXC reference S4 Sharpe on the same coins, and S4 Newey-West t >= 2.0 (5 lags)
G3_venue_replication.verdict: PASS if both venues pass; MIXED if one; FAIL if neither. Run once.
